title: CellDefinition
description: Common contract for both worker and orchestrator Probe Cells (Issue #298 / Probe Cell Fabric). There is no separate 'kind' field: orchestrator-ness is expressed structurally by the presence of a non-null `roster` (child cell_ids). A Cell is System-scoped; cell_id is unique within a System and is conventionally system_id + component_id (one logical Probe Cell per approved probe/component). This schema does not itself carry system_id -- system ownership is enforced at the persistence/API layer, not embedded in the portable contract document.

cell_id.description: Unique within a System. Convention: system_id + component_id for a probe-backed Cell.

roster.description: Child cell_ids. Null means a worker Cell. A non-null array (possibly empty) means an orchestrator Cell.

mission.description: Optional override of the Role Card's mission for this specific Cell instance.
